comment: The nine production runs (md/PLAN.md stage S5; entry of 6 Oct 2026, 9:15 PM IST, point 2; md/PRODUCTION.md) with the primary zinc set 2e, empirical (MCPB.py step 2e), systems $SYS/bonded_2e/X, N, R, terms at N2 as built. One after another in the order X1 N1 R1, X2 N2 R2, X3 N3 R3: each waits for the one before it, so the chain stops at the first run that fails; X1 waits for the validation run X0_2e, whose gate G-V was judged on the Pi before this file was added. Each run: full protocol of md/protocol.json, 100 ns in segments of 5 ns, --resume, so a run that was stopped goes on from its last complete segment. Time limit of one attempt: 6 hours (a run takes about 3 hours); a run that reaches it is ended and continued by the next attempt.

tasks.title: production run X1: 100 ns from start X, replica 1, zinc set 2e (primary), terms at N2 as built
tasks.success_test: python3 "$MD/gpu/queue.py" json "$RUNS/bonded_2e/X1/manifest.json" run_id=X1 status=complete production.complete=true production.completed_ns=100 test_only=false
